snippet.title: Sensory Overload - Gameplay
snippet.description:
I'm making Sensory Overload, a game designed to mess with your senses.

Each level targets a different part of your brain: depth perception, balance, spatial awareness, etc.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4403510/Sensory_Overload/

Join the Discord server to follow the progress.
https://discord.gg/xcmMSe6pBM

Song "Into the Night" by Creo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pTaMImXesvA
